To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
feeding 200 µg Cr/kg along with 62.50 to 125 mg YS/kg in diets fed to growing pigs in a commercial environment can improve performance and carcass characteristics.

feeding Cr propionate along YS extract to finishing pigs increased (quadratic) ADG and tended to improve (linear) ADFI, and that feeding 62.5 or 125 mg of YS-based feed-grade concentrate to finishing pigs decreased (quadratic) final BW and hot-car-cass weight.
adding Cr propionate and/or YS extract to diets fed to finishing pigs housed in a typical commercial environment had minimal effects on growth performance and feed efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of chromium propionate as a feed additive to enhance the growth performance of swine.
determining the effects of feeding Cr propionate and YS on growth performance and meat quality in a commercial swine facility.
the effects of chromium propionate (200 µg/kg; Cr) and a YS-based feed additive on performance and carcass characteristics of finishing pigs in commercial conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

adding Cr propionate to diets fed to pigs in commercial conditions did not consistently improve performance, however, the addition of YS extract to diets fed to growing pigs in commercial conditions resulted in modest changes in performance.
feeding Cr propionate along YS led to a modest increase in performance with the largest benefits being observed with 200 μg/kg Cr propionate and 125 mg YS-based feed concentrate.

adding Cr propionate and YS led to a modest increase in growth performance with the greatest improvement observed when 200 µg Cr and 125 YS-based feed concentrate were included in finishing pig diets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of YS-based feed-grade concentrate in diets for finishing pigs may have the greatest potential to improve performance in pigs fed diets with added Cr propionate.
Cr propionate and YS extract can be fed to pigs in commercial environments, but that the effects are likely to be modest.
adding Cr propionate alone increased ADFI and backfat depth and inclusion of Yucca schidegra-based feed grade concentrate increased ADFI, but did not affect ADG or gain:feed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Cr and YS are safe to use in commercial diets, but the benefits of these additives are not clear and require further research.
the addition of YS to finishing pig diets can improve growth performance and carcasses can be of acceptable quality.
the inclusion of 125 mg/kg feed grade concentrate of YS in diets fed 200 µ/kg of chromium propionate may provide a modest improvement in performance of finishing pigs in a commercial environment.
